name: RegBanks
desc: register banks 0-3 (8 bytes each: A W C B E D L H); bank 1 TC1 handler; bank 2 INT3 handler; bank 3 SIO2 receiver

name: ColumnDots
desc: dot values of the column being prepared (copied from 0xB8-0xD6)

name: LineCounter
desc: mechanism step counter; indexes the heat-compensation curve

name: MechState
desc: mechanism state (0 idle; 01-10 print columns; 11 homing; 12 band start; 13 band advance; 14 top margin; 15 bottom margin; 16 feed only; 17 button feed; 18 stop)

name: HeatBase
desc: base time from the temperature table 0xCEF6

name: MechRequests
desc: requests to the mechanism (also low 5 bits of an encoder count)

name: Status
desc: printer status as sent (bit-reversed: internal bit k = protocol bit 7-k)

name: MarginBefore
desc: margin before printing (print argument byte 1 high nibble)

name: MarginAfter
desc: margin after printing (argument byte 1 low nibble)

name: FeedOnlyAmount
desc: feed amount for a print with 0 sheets

name: CmdRequests
desc: commands posted by the receiver to the main loop

name: EncoderTimeout
desc: ticks without an encoder pulse (jam at overflow)

name: CamTimeout
desc: ticks without a cam sensor change (jam at overflow)

name: StartDelay
desc: tick counter before a job starts

name: MechSubState
desc: sub-state of the current mechanism state

name: LineBuf
desc: image bytes fetched from SRAM for printing (32-byte chunks)

name: ColumnSource
desc: bytes the current column is extracted from

name: StrobeA_P0
desc: strobe tick table A for P0 (rows 0-7): one byte per TC1 tick

name: StrobeA_P1
desc: strobe tick table A for P1 (rows 8-15)

name: StrobeB_P0
desc: strobe tick table B for P0

name: StrobeB_P1
desc: strobe tick table B for P1

name: PktArgs
desc: first 4 payload bytes of non-data packets

name: PowerOffTimer
desc: counted up in the idle mechanism state; on overflow P5.3 (power hold) is cleared

name: HeatCurvePtr
desc: pointer to the heat-compensation curve (0xDB88 or 0xDC7B)

name: ActivityTimer
desc: reloaded with 0xF3 by every received byte; idle reset when it wraps
